_note: EMPIRICAL stem-wordiness bounds for SAT Math, measured from official College Board sources to calibrate the author's concision (build/author2.mjs WBAND). 'prose words' = question text up to the final '?' (drops trailing MCQ choices).
sources: taxonomy/exemplars.clean.json — 34 official Skills-Insight items, band-labeled (per-band bounds)

official_practice_test_10._from: Digital SAT Practice Test #10, both Math modules (approx; figure ASCII-noise filtered)

takeaways: Median SAT Math stem ≈ 18 words; about half are under 20 words.
Only ~10% of stems exceed 50 words, and those are typically higher-band modeling problems.
Wordiness rises with band but modestly; low-band items must be terse.
